description: Cancels an unpaid invoice so the buyer can no longer pay it, for example when the order was called off. Needs a store key (npx stablevoy-mcp login). Pass the invoiceId from create_invoice, list_invoices or get_invoice. Without store every connected store is tried and only the one that owns the invoice cancels it. It works only while no payment has been seen; otherwise it returns invoice_not_cancellable and the invoice stays as it is. Money that still arrives later is marked paid_late, and cancelling twice returns the invoice unchanged. Use get_invoice first if you are not sure of its status. A failure comes back as an error with its code and what to do, for example rate_limited with the seconds to wait.

store.description: Store id or exact store name from list_stores. Needed only when several stores are connected.

name: cancel_invoice
title: Cancel an unpaid invoice
